resources.string: Tap each button. Android opens a settings page: switch it on, then come back here.
Let Ducky float over other apps
Allow reminders at the exact time
Don\'t let battery saver put Ducky to sleep
No reminders yet. Tap + Add, or tap the floating Ducky any time.
Try it: remind me in 1 minute
Change the material, colour and accessories any time.
Floats over your apps, keeps you on track and makes every day a little more joyful. Tap me!
This is your test reminder. Quack!
Ducky will quack in about a minute. You can leave the app.
Due now. Tap Delete when it\'s done.
Please type what Ducky should remind you about.
That time has already passed. Please pick a later time.
Ducky is napping. Reminders still arrive as notifications. Open the Ducky app to bring it back.
Your reminders when they are due, with a quack
Android requires this while the duck is on screen. You can hide it.

string-array.name: talk_one
string-array.item: Hey friend! Don\'t forget “%1$s” 💛
Psst… “%1$s” is still waiting for you 🐥
You\'ve got this! Just “%1$s” left ✨

string-array.name: talk_many
string-array.item: You have %1$d things to do. Shall we start with “%2$s”? 💪
%1$d little tasks left. Let\'s do them together, one by one 🐥
Hi! First up: “%2$s”. I\'ll cheer you on 📣

string-array.name: talk_none
string-array.item: All done for now! You\'re amazing ✨
Nothing on the list. Time for a little break? ☕

string-array.name: talk_praise
string-array.item: Yay, nice work! 🎉
Quack quack! Well done 💛
One down! I\'m so proud of you 🐥

string-array.name: talk_one_zen
string-array.item: Breathe in. Breathe out. Now, “%1$s”. 🪷
The river does not hurry, yet “%1$s” will be done. 🍃
One task, one moment: “%1$s”. 🙏

string-array.name: talk_many_zen
string-array.item: %1$d things await, like leaves on the water. Begin with “%2$s”. 🍃
A journey of %1$d steps begins with “%2$s”. 🪷
Do not carry all %1$d at once. Just “%2$s”, gently. 🙏

string-array.name: talk_none_zen
string-array.item: Nothing to do. Simply be. 🪷
An empty list is a peaceful mind. 🍃

string-array.name: talk_praise_zen
string-array.item: Well done. Let it go. 🍃
Another step on the path. 🙏
Released, like a breath. 🪷

string-array.name: talk_one_mean
string-array.item: Seriously? “%1$s” is STILL not done? 🙄
Wow. “%1$s” is just sitting there. Like you. 😒
Do “%1$s” already. I\'m not asking twice. 😤

string-array.name: talk_many_mean
string-array.item: %1$d things left?! What have you even been doing? 🙄
Ugh, %1$d tasks. Start with “%2$s”, slowpoke. 😒
“%2$s” isn\'t going to do itself, genius. %1$d to go. 😤

string-array.name: talk_none_mean
string-array.item: Nothing left? Huh. Didn\'t think you had it in you. 😏
Empty list. Don\'t let it go to your head. 🙄

string-array.name: talk_praise_mean
string-array.item: Finally. Took you long enough. 😒
Fine, that one\'s done. Don\'t get cocky. 😏
Wow, a miracle. 🙄

string-array.name: talk_one_boss
string-array.item: Boss, one item pending: “%1$s”. Awaiting your action. 📋
Status report, Boss: “%1$s” remains open. 🗂️
Boss, a reminder: “%1$s” is on today\'s agenda. 📌

string-array.name: talk_many_boss
string-array.item: Boss, %1$d items on today\'s agenda. I recommend starting with “%2$s”. 📋
Briefing: %1$d tasks pending. Priority one is “%2$s”. 🗂️
Boss, %1$d open items. Shall I put “%2$s” at the top? 📌

string-array.name: talk_none_boss
string-array.item: Boss, all items are cleared. Excellent work today. 📋
Report: no pending tasks. Your schedule is clear, Boss. 🗂️

string-array.name: talk_praise_boss
string-array.item: Noted, Boss. Item closed. ✅
Excellent decision, Boss. Marked as done. 📋
Report updated: one item fewer, Boss. 🗂️
